रोजगार अनुबंधों और कर्मचारियों की अनुशासनात्मक प्रक्रियाओं को नियंत्रित करने वाला औपचारिक वैधानिक कानूनी ढांचा
काम के प्रति एक समूह का सामूहिक दृष्टिकोण और भावनात्मक कल्याण

questions.question_english:
In the context of organizational behavior,
     ‘Morale’ is best defined as:
options_english: An individual worker’s innate biological drive and physiological motivation to fulfill basic survival needs
The formal statutory legal framework governing employment contracts and staff disciplinary procedures
The collective attitude and emotional well-being of a group toward work
The precise mathematical calculation and statistical measurement of productive work output per teacher hour
questions.explanation_english: In organizational behavior, morale describes the collective psychological state, prevailing attitude, and shared emotional well-being of a group toward their assigned duties and organizational environment. High morale manifests as team spirit, mutual trust, organizational enthusiasm, and commitment to shared goals, reflecting how positively employees view their work environment and overall institutional culture.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। संगठनात्मक व्यवहार में, मोराल एक समूह की सामूहिक मनोवैज्ञानिक स्थिति, प्रचलित दृष्टिकोण, और उनके निर्धारित कार्यों और संगठनात्मक वातावरण के प्रति साझा भावनात्मक कल्याण का वर्णन करता है। उच्च मोराल टीम भावना, आपसी विश्वास, संगठनात्मक उत्साह, और साझा लक्ष्यों के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता के रूप में प्रकट होता है, जो यह दर्शाता है कि कर्मचारी अपने कार्य वातावरण और समग्र संस्थागत संस्कृति को कितनी सकारात्मकता से देखते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) The collective attitude and emotional well-being of a group toward work

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In organizational behavior, morale describes the collective psychological state, prevailing attitude, and shared emotional well-being of a group toward their assigned duties and organizational environment.

questions.question_english: According to the RTE Act, what is the required percentage of women members in the School Management Committee?
questions.explanation_english: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act of 2009 mandates gender representation within school governance. Specifically, statutory regulations require that at least 50 percent of the total members of the School Management Committee must be women, promoting gender equity and empowering female parents and community stakeholders in institutional decision-making.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आरटीई अधिनियम के अनुसार, स्कूल प्रबंधन समिति के सदस्यों में से कम से कम 50 प्रतिशत महिलाएँ होनी चाहिए। यह प्रावधान लिंग समानता को बढ़ावा देने और महिला अभिभावकों तथा समुदाय के हितधारकों को संस्थागत निर्णय-निर्माण में सशक्त बनाने के लिए है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) 50%
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act of 2009 mandates gender representation within school governance.

questions.question_english: In the decision-making process, what does ‘Heuristics’ refer to?
options_english: Rigorous mathematical algorithms and statistical formulas designed for exact decision optimization
Mental shortcuts or rules of thumb used to simplify decisions
Binding statutory legal mandates issued directly by the state central education board authority
The established formal organizational grievance redressal policies and administrative procedures
questions.explanation_english: In administrative decision-making theory, heuristics are practical mental shortcuts, intuitive rules of thumb, or simplified guidelines used to make quick decisions under conditions of limited time, complex information, or cognitive constraints. While heuristics speed up problem-solving, they can occasionally introduce cognitive biases and systematic decision errors into administrative choices. The other options describe formal methods or legal mandates that do not align with the concept of heuristics.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। प्रशासनिक निर्णय लेने के सिद्धांत में, ह्यूरिस्टिक्स व्यावहारिक मानसिक शॉर्टकट, सहज नियम या सरल दिशानिर्देश होते हैं जो सीमित समय, जटिल जानकारी या संज्ञानात्मक बाधाओं की स्थितियों में त्वरित निर्णय लेने के लिए उपयोग किए जाते हैं। जबकि ह्यूरिस्टिक्स समस्या-समाधान को तेज करते हैं, वे कभी-कभी संज्ञानात्मक पूर्वाग्रह और प्रणालीगत निर्णय त्रुटियों को प्रशासनिक विकल्पों में शामिल कर सकते हैं। अन्य विकल्प औपचारिक विधियों या कानूनी आदेशों का वर्णन करते हैं जो ह्यूरिस्टिक्स की अवधारणा के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Mental shortcuts or rules of thumb used to simplify decisions

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In administrative decision-making theory, heuristics are practical mental shortcuts, intuitive rules of thumb, or simplified guidelines used to make quick decisions under conditions of limited time, complex information, or cognitive constraints.

questions.question_english: According to Halpin and Croft, an 'Open Climate' in a school is characterized by:
options_english: High disengagement among teachers combined with high professional aloofness and detachment of the Principal
High esprit de corps among teachers and a supportive Principal
High administrative hindrance created by management coupled with pervasive low employee morale throughout the school
An authoritarian, dictatorial Principal leading an entirely submissive, passive, and unmotivated teaching staff
questions.explanation_english: According to the organizational climate framework developed by Halpin and Croft, an Open Climate is characterized by high teacher esprit de corps, strong professional commitment, low disengagement, and supportive, non-restrictive principal leadership. In this positive environment, teachers experience high job satisfaction, work collaboratively, and receive constructive support from management.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हैलपिन और क्रॉफ्ट के अनुसार, 'खुला वातावरण' शिक्षकों के बीच उच्च esprit de corps, मजबूत पेशेवर प्रतिबद्धता, निम्न असंबद्धता, और सहायक, गैर-प्रतिबंधात्मक प्राचार्य नेतृत्व की विशेषता है। इस सकारात्मक वातावरण में, शिक्षक उच्च नौकरी संतोष का अनुभव करते हैं, सहयोगात्मक रूप से काम करते हैं, और प्रबंधन से रचनात्मक समर्थन प्राप्त करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) High esprit de corps among teachers and a supportive Principal

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: According to the organizational climate framework developed by Halpin and Croft, an Open Climate is characterized by high teacher esprit de corps, strong professional commitment, low disengagement, and supportive, non-restrictive principal leadership.

questions.question_english: Which management theorists coined the concept of 'POSDCORB'?
options_english: Frederick Winslow Taylor and Henry L. Gantt
Henri Fayol and Maximilian Weber
Luther Gulick and Lyndall Urwick
Elton Mayo and Mary Parker Follett
questions.explanation_english: The management acronym POSDCORB was coined by Luther Gulick and Lyndall Urwick in their 1937 paper on administrative science. It outlines the core functional responsibilities of an executive administrator. The acronym represents Planning, Organizing, Staffing, Directing, Coordinating, Reporting, and Budgeting, providing a structured framework for administrative processes across public and educational management systems.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रबंधन संक्षेप POSDCORB को लूथर गुलिक और लिंडाल उर्विक द्वारा 1937 में प्रशासनिक विज्ञान पर अपने पेपर में बनाया गया था। यह एक कार्यकारी प्रशासक की मुख्य कार्यात्मक जिम्मेदारियों को रेखांकित करता है। यह संक्षेप योजना, संगठन, स्टाफिंग, निर्देशन, समन्वय, रिपोर्टिंग और बजटिंग का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जो सार्वजनिक और शैक्षणिक प्रबंधन प्रणालियों में प्रशासनिक प्रक्रियाओं के लिए एक संरचित ढांचा प्रदान करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Luther Gulick and Lyndall Urwick
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The management acronym POSDCORB was coined by Luther Gulick and Lyndall Urwick in their 1937 paper on administrative science.

questions.question_english: Which of the following barriers to communication involves filtering or altering information to make it appear more favorable to the receiver?
options_english: Information overload
Semantic barrier
Selective perception
Filtering
questions.explanation_english: Filtering occurs when a sender deliberately manipulates or selectively alters information before transmission to make it appear more favorable to the receiver. In educational hierarchies, filtering happens when subordinates conceal bad news, downplay administrative problems, or alter operational reports to avoid displeasure from supervisors, distorting administrative decision-making data.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। छानना तब होता है जब एक प्रेषक जानबूझकर जानकारी को प्रसारण से पहले हेरफेर करता है या चयनात्मक रूप से बदलता है ताकि यह रिसीवर के लिए अधिक अनुकूल दिखाई दे। शैक्षणिक पदानुक्रम में, छानना तब होता है जब अधीनस्थ बुरी खबरों को छुपाते हैं, प्रशासनिक समस्याओं को कम करते हैं, या पर्यवेक्षकों की नाराजगी से बचने के लिए परिचालन रिपोर्ट को बदलते हैं, जिससे प्रशासनिक निर्णय लेने के डेटा में विकृति आती है।

questions.question_english:
The ‘Trait Theory’ of leadership is based on the
    fundamental assumption that:
options_english: Leadership skills and competencies can be effectively learned through extensive professional training
Leaders are born with inherent physical and psychological traits
Leadership effectiveness depends entirely on specific environmental and situational contingencies
Leaders emerge naturally as a direct result of a major organizational crisis or emergency
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'b' because Trait Theory posits that effective leadership is fundamentally tied to inherent personal qualities, physical attributes, intellectual capabilities, and psychological traits. This perspective suggests that leaders are born rather than made, possessing distinct innate characteristics—such as intelligence, decisiveness, self-confidence, and charisma—that naturally distinguish them from non-leaders regardless of environmental context.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Leaders are born with inherent physical and psychological traits

questions.question_english: A Principal has observed that despite having state-of-the-art infrastructure and high salaries (hygiene factors satisfied), teacher morale and innovative teaching are stagnating. questions.explanation_english: The correct option is to provide professional achievement, pedagogical autonomy, and recognition. According to Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, once hygiene factors such as physical facilities and salaries are satisfied, enhancing motivation requires the introduction of intrinsic motivators. Principals can invigorate stagnating staff by offering meaningful opportunities for professional achievement, granting pedagogical autonomy, providing sincere recognition, and expanding leadership roles to meet higher-order growth needs. The other options focus on hygiene factors or punitive measures, which do not address the intrinsic motivation necessary for improving morale.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। हर्ज़बर्ग के द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत के अनुसार, जब हाइजीन कारक जैसे भौतिक सुविधाएँ और वेतन संतुष्ट होते हैं, तो प्रेरणा बढ़ाने के लिए आंतरिक प्रेरकों की पेशकश करनी होती है। प्रधान ठहराव में फंसे स्टाफ को व्यावसायिक उपलब्धियों के लिए सार्थक अवसर प्रदान करके, शैक्षणिक स्वायत्तता देकर, ईमानदार मान्यता देकर और नेतृत्व की भूमिकाओं का विस्तार करके प्रेरित कर सकते हैं। अन्य विकल्प हाइजीन कारकों या दंडात्मक उपायों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं, जो मनोबल सुधारने के लिए आवश्यक आंतरिक प्रेरणा को संबोधित नहीं करते।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Provide professional achievement, pedagogical autonomy, and recognition

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: According to Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory, once hygiene factors like physical facilities and salaries are satisfied, elevating motivation requires offering intrinsic motivators.

questions.question_english:
Which principle of organization states that a
    subordinate should receive orders from and be
    accountable to only one superior?
options_english: Span of control
Unity of direction
Unity of command
Scalar chain
questions.explanation_english:
The principle of unity of command dictates that
    each employee should receive direct orders from,
    and remain accountable to, only one immediate
    supervisor. In educational management,
    adherence to this classical principle prevents
    conflicting instructions, reduces role ambiguity,
    simplifies reporting lines, and maintains clear
    organizational accountability across teaching
    and non-teaching staff within the institutional
    administrative hierarchy.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (c) है। आदेश की एकता का सिद्धांत यह बताता है कि
    प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को केवल एक तत्काल पर्यवेक्षक से
    सीधे आदेश प्राप्त करना चाहिए और उसी के प्रति
    जिम्मेदार रहना चाहिए। शैक्षणिक प्रबंधन में,
    इस पारंपरिक सिद्धांत का पालन विरोधाभासी निर्देशों
    को रोकता है, भूमिका की अस्पष्टता को कम करता है,
    रिपोर्टिंग लाइनों को सरल बनाता है, और संस्थागत
    प्रशासनिक पदानुक्रम में शिक्षण और गैर-शिक्षण स्टाफ
    के बीच स्पष्ट संगठनात्मक जिम्मेदारी बनाए रखता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Unity of command

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The principle of unity of command dictates that each employee should receive direct orders from, and remain accountable to, only one immediate supervisor.

questions.question_english: Which of the following best demonstrates the principle of ‘Equity’ (from Fayol’s principles) in maintaining high morale?
options_english: Paying all teaching staff members identically regardless of their individual qualifications or experience
Applying rules, workload distribution, and rewards fairly to all staff
Ensuring a strictly equal numerical balance of male and female students across every individual classroom
Distributing the exact same physical resources equally to all academic departments regardless of specific needs
questions.explanation_english: Henri Fayol’s principle of Equity emphasizes applying fairness, justice, and impartiality across all administrative practices. In school management, equity manifests when administrators enforce policy rules consistently, distribute teaching workloads fairly, and grant professional rewards without favoritism, thereby maintaining organizational trust and building high morale among all employees.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। हेनरी फायोल का समानता का सिद्धांत सभी प्रशासनिक प्रथाओं में निष्पक्षता, न्याय और पक्षपात रहितता को लागू करने पर जोर देता है। स्कूल प्रबंधन में, समानता तब प्रकट होती है जब प्रशासक नीति नियमों को लगातार लागू करते हैं, शिक्षण कार्यभार को निष्पक्षता से वितरित करते हैं, और बिना पक्षपात के पेशेवर पुरस्कार प्रदान करते हैं, इस प्रकार सभी कर्मचारियों के बीच संगठनात्मक विश्वास बनाए रखते हैं और उच्च मनोबल का निर्माण करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Applying rules, workload distribution, and rewards fairly to all staff
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Henri Fayol’s principle of Equity emphasizes applying fairness, justice, and impartiality across all administrative practices.

questions.question_english: A Principal aims to introduce a new remedial teaching program. According to Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, a teacher will be highly motivated to participate if:
options_english: The teacher believes basic physiological and safety needs will be completely fulfilled through participation
The teacher is closely monitored, strictly supervised, and threatened with formal administrative disciplinary action
The Principal issues a direct administrative order that mandates compliance across all academic departments
The teacher expects effort leads to performance, performance yields reward, and the reward is valued
questions.explanation_english: Vroom’s Expectancy Theory suggests that motivation is influenced by three cognitive perceptions: Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence. A teacher experiences high motivation when they believe that their effort will lead to successful performance, that this performance will result in identifiable rewards, and that these rewards hold personal value and psychological appeal.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। व्रूम के अपेक्षा सिद्धांत के अनुसार, एक शिक्षक तब अत्यधिक प्रेरित होगा जब वह मानता है कि प्रयास प्रदर्शन की ओर ले जाता है, प्रदर्शन पुरस्कार लाता है, और पुरस्कार का मूल्य है। यह सिद्धांत बताता है कि व्यक्तिगत प्रयास से सफल प्रदर्शन और उसके परिणामस्वरूप मिलने वाले पुरस्कारों का मूल्यांकन प्रेरणा को प्रभावित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The teacher expects effort leads to performance, performance yields reward, and the reward is valued
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Vroom’s Expectancy Theory posits that motivation is driven by three cognitive perceptions.

questions.question_english: Which theorist defined morale as the extent to which an individual's needs are satisfied and the extent to which the individual perceives that satisfaction as arising from their overall job situation?
options_english: Milton Blum
Robert Guion
Edwin Flippo
Keith Davis
questions.explanation_english: Robert Guion defined job morale as the extent to which an individual’s needs are satisfied and the extent to which the individual perceives that satisfaction as stemming directly from their overall job situation. His operational definition emphasizes the psychological alignment between personal need fulfillment, environmental perceptions, and total workplace satisfaction within organizational structures.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। रॉबर्ट गुइन ने नौकरी के मनोबल को इस प्रकार परिभाषित किया है कि यह उस मात्रा को दर्शाता है जिसमें व्यक्ति की आवश्यकताएँ संतुष्ट होती हैं और यह मात्रा कि व्यक्ति उस संतोष को अपनी कुल नौकरी की स्थिति से उत्पन्न मानता है। उनका परिचालनात्मक परिभाषा व्यक्तिगत आवश्यकता की पूर्ति, पर्यावरणीय धारणाओं और संगठनात्मक संरचनाओं के भीतर कुल कार्यस्थल संतोष के बीच मनोवैज्ञानिक संरेखण पर जोर देती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Robert Guion

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Robert Guion defined job morale as the extent to which an individual’s needs are satisfied and the extent to which the individual perceives that satisfaction as stemming directly from their overall job situation.

questions.question_english:
Community participation in school management
     primarily aids in:
options_english: Directly bypassing the official Directorate of Education disciplinary rules and regulations
Significantly reducing the administrative and academic workload burden of the Head of School
Privatizing and commercializing the financial assets and physical facilities of government schools
Enhancing transparency, accountability, and local relevance of schooling
questions.explanation_english: Community participation in school management through bodies like School Management Committees strengthens operational oversight, transparency, and administrative accountability. Involving local stakeholders aligns educational delivery with local contextual needs, builds trust between schools and families, encourages resource mobilization, and holds institutional leadership accountable for delivering quality education and maintaining safe learning environments.
